name: Semico Capital Berhad
overview: Semico Capital Berhad 于2026年1月完成首次公开募股（IPO）并在马来西亚交易所上市。年内，公司与 Chan Kean Seng 及 Kosmare Sdn. Bhd. 签订合资协议，在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 购物中心经营家庭娱乐中心，涉及街机、卡片及奖品机、商品零售等业务，并以授权品牌运营。此外，公司持续派发季度股息。
overview_en: Semico Capital Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) and listed on Bursa Malaysia in January 2026. During the year, the company entered into a joint venture agreement with Chan Kean Seng and Kosmare Sdn. Bhd. to operate a family entertainment centre at Pavilion Bukit Jalil shopping mall, involving arcade, card and prize machines, merchandise retail and related activities under a licensed brand. The company also continued to declare quarterly dividends.

segments.name: 家庭娱乐中心运营
segments.note: 通过合资方式在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 开设并运营家庭娱乐中心。
segments.note_en: Established a joint venture to operate a family entertainment centre at Pavilion Bukit Jalil.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Chan Kean Seng 及 Kosmare Sdn. Bhd. 签订合资协议，在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 购物中心经营家庭娱乐中心，包括街机、卡片及奖品机、商品零售及相关活动，并以授权品牌运营。
actions.text_en: Entered into a joint venture and shareholders' agreement with Chan Kean Seng and Kosmare Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年1月完成首次公开募股并在马来西亚交易所上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on Bursa Malaysia in January 2026.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资方式新增家庭娱乐中心运营业务，在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 经营以授权品牌运营的家庭娱乐中心。
model_changes.text_en: Added family entertainment centre operations through a joint venture, operating a licensed-brand family entertainment centre at Pavilion Bukit Jalil.
